verdict.rationale: The docs show documents being pushed from a primary database into Typesense and added to an existing collection, which then becomes searchable. That implies incremental indexing without a rebuild. Nothing in the pack addresses updates, deletes, or indexing latency. missing for 10: documented update/upsert and delete operations, explicit near-real-time visibility or latency claims, evidence that no reindex is required, independent or hands-on corroboration
